questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence. P. having the opportunity of observing people's Q. we respect and appreciate their point of views R. the advantage of travelling different places and S. culture, custom and lifestyle, is that
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

P. having the opportunity of observing people's
Q. we respect and appreciate their point of views
R. the advantage of travelling different places and
S. culture, custom and lifestyle, is that
questions.solution: The correct answer is: RPSQ. The sentence begins with the subject "the advantage of travelling different places and" (R), followed by the gerund phrase "having the opportunity of observing people's" (P). This leads into the objects of observation, "culture, custom and lifestyle, is that" (S), and concludes with the result of that advantage, "we respect and appreciate their point of views" (Q). The complete sentence is: "The advantage of travelling different places and having the opportunity of observing people's culture, custom and lifestyle, is that we respect and appreciate their point of views."

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. The painting was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.
The painting was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

options.text: The painting was being admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.
options.html: The painting was being admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

options.text: Art enthusiasts from around the world admired the painting.
options.html: Art enthusiasts from around the world admired the painting.

options.text: Art enthusiasts from around the world have admired the painting.
options.html: Art enthusiasts from around the world have admired the painting.

options.text: The painting has been admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.
options.html: The painting has been admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Art enthusiasts from around the world admired the painting. 

The conversion from the question to the answer is Passive to Active.

In the passive voice sentence, "The painting" is the subject receiving the action, and "was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world" indicates the action being performed on it. To convert it to active voice, "art enthusiasts from around the world" becomes the subject performing the action, and "admired the painting" becomes the action they performed on the object, "the painting." The structure changes from Passive (Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject) to Active (Subject + V2 + Object).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. He has the _______ to express his thoughts.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.
He has the _______ to express his thoughts.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1.

Key Points

  • The word "right" refers to something that is morally good, justified, or acceptable. (सही)
    • Example: Everyone has the right to express their opinions freely.
  • "right" refers to having the freedom or authority to do something. (अधिकार)
    • Example: He has the right to express his thoughts.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Ride (सवारी): To sit on and control the movement of an animal, typically a horse, or a vehicle.
    • Example: I love to ride my bicycle through the park.
  • Write (लिखना): To mark letters, words, or other symbols on a surface, typically paper, with a pen, pencil, or similar instrument.
    • Example: She likes to write stories in her free time.
  • Rite (अनुष्ठान): A religious or other solemn ceremony or act.
    • Example: The wedding rite was performed with great devotion.
